# braintrust_function (Data Source)

Reads an existing Braintrust function by ID or name and project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Function ID. Provide either id or name with project_id.
- `name` (String) Display name of the function.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID, required for name lookup.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Textual description.
- `function_data_json` (String) Function implementation as JSON.
- `function_schema_json` (String) Optional parameter and return schema as JSON.
- `function_type` (String) Function type.
- `metadata_json` (String) Metadata as JSON.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `prompt_data_json` (String) Optional prompt configuration as JSON.
- `slug` (String) Unique function slug.
- `tags` (List of String) Function tags.
- `xact_id` (String) Transaction ID of the function version.
